# Portfolix v0.1.13
## 更新内容
- 新账本默认提供 Apple、NVIDIA、BTC 三项示例持仓，可自行编辑或删除；已有账本保持原样。 - 每次完全退出后重新打开 App（包括首次打开），自动刷新一次价格，独立于后台定时刷新策略。 - 新增 Exa、AnySearch 搜索支持，支持多个搜索来源并发调用，改善追问时的搜索主题、引用与次数统计。 - 优化 AI 回答格式解析和引用展示，减少异常内容对阅读的干扰。 - 选择器和侧边栏加入流畅的紫色滑动选中效果，移除侧边栏的灰色悬停背景。 - 无盈亏记录时仍显示完整日历、柱状图坐标和收益趋势零线，并优化首页日期文字与金额显示。
## What's New
- New ledgers start with editable Apple, NVIDIA, and BTC sample holdings. Existing ledgers remain unchanged. - Supported asset prices refresh once on every fresh app launch, including the first launch, independently of background updates. - Added Exa and AnySearch, concurrent search providers, and improved follow-up search relevance, citations, and search statistics. - Improved AI response parsing and citation display for more readable answers. - Added smooth purple selection animations to selectors and the sidebar, and removed the sidebar's gray hover background. - Kept the calendar, bar-chart axes, and return-trend zero line visible without P&L history, and refined dashboard date and amount typography.
Build 26 · Apple Silicon · macOS 15+

# Portfolix v0.1.12 (Build 25)
- 修复 Agent 分析中证据校验误判导致的报错与回退。 - 改善分析自动修复和失败诊断。 - 更新持仓时，自动换算的成本价最多保留 8 位小数。
## What's New
- Fixed incorrect evidence validation causing Agent analysis failures and fallback. - Improved automatic report repair and failure diagnostics. - Limited calculated unit costs in holding updates to 8 decimal places.
Apple Silicon · macOS 15+
